conventions.heading: the heading the file should sit under; "(intro, ...)" means right under the first code example of the page
conventions.width: pixel width of the file; Studio screenshots are 3200 wide for 1600 CSS pixels (displayWidth), so show them at 1600
conventions.source: every rendered file comes from the real kinetograph CLI (`still` and `render`); "extended example" means the same API as the page with more design

studioWindow.caption: Agent chat on the left, the preview in the middle with the timeline under it, the inspector on the right.
studioWindow.placement: docs/studio/index, right under the intro and the `npx kinetograph studio` command

skipped.what: plugin panel (a plugin card in the Props tab)
skipped.why: no example project uses a plugin with a panel, and the plugins on the site are unpublished; the Plugins list is shown instead (studio/plugins-dark.webp)
the tips pages hold prompts and no code example of their own; the making-videos pictures cover the same ideas
